queries.query: Help me refactor a payment service that mixes business rules with the Stripe client, time-based retries, and random id generation so the core logic becomes easy to unit test.
We are designing a new order workflow service and need advice on dependency seams, deterministic clocks, and which parts should be covered by unit, integration, and contract tests.
Review this legacy batch module for hidden IO and concurrency dependencies and suggest how to make the architecture more testable without relying on flaky sleeps.
Write a project plan for increasing automated test coverage across the team next quarter.
Run the existing Playwright and unit test suites, summarize the failures, and tell me which tests are flaky.
Review the public HTTP API contract for pagination, error format, idempotency, and versioning compatibility.
